advice: Mark tone fades while it plays: OS voice processing is active. Turn off audio enhancements / noise suppression, try --exclusive, or use a USB microphone.
Signal is weak: raise the volume or move the transmitter closer.
In-band SNR below 15 dB: reduce room noise or move closer.
Twist -240.0 dB: the soft fallback compensates, but a flatter speaker or a different position helps.
